verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is that static pages can be regenerated on a schedule (vercel-docs-21). That is page revalidation, not general recurring job scheduling. Vercel Workflows offers durable multi-step logic with retries and event waits (vercel-docs-37), but nothing documents running those workflows on a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: documented cron or scheduled-job capability, recurring triggers for Workflows/functions, schedule management via CLI/API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
